summary.text: Michael Melerine is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 6 (Caddo Parish), and was elected in 2023, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Michael Melerine's occupation as Attorney.
It lists education as B.S. and J.D., Louisiana State University.

The page lists committee assignments including Civil Law and Procedure, Insurance, and Labor and Industrial Relations, and caucus affiliations including the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
